title: Product feedback — mixed praise and complaints, lists
raw: okay so feedback on the new dashboard so the good stuff first uh the new filter sidebar is way better than what we had before it's actually usable now and the loading speed improved a lot like noticeably faster and the date picker finally works correctly and those were the three things everyone complained about most so good job on those but there are still some issues one the export button is still in the wrong place like it should be at the top of the page not hidden in the settings dropdown because people use it constantly two the mobile version is basically unusable the tables don't scroll horizontally and everything is just squished three there's no way to save custom views which was supposed to be in this release but apparently got cut and that is a big deal because our power users build specific filters every single day four the color coding on the status column doesn't match the legend which is just confusing and five the undo button only goes back one step which is not enough when you're doing bulk edits
reference:
Feedback on the new dashboard:

**What's working:**
- The new filter sidebar is way better and actually usable
- Loading speed improved noticeably
- Date picker finally works correctly

Those were the top three complaints — good work.

**Still needs fixing:**
1. Export button is in the wrong place. It's hidden in the settings dropdown but people use it constantly — it should be at the top of the page.
2. Mobile version is basically unusable. Tables don't scroll horizontally, everything is squished.
3. No way to save custom views. This was supposed to be in this release and it's a big deal — power users build specific filters every day.
4. Color coding on the status column doesn't match the legend.
5. Undo only goes back one step, which isn't enough for bulk edits.
